text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval from Toronto and East York Community Council to extend the overnight on-street permit parking hours on Queensdale Avenue, between Monarch Park Avenue and Linnsmore Crescent, from 11:00 p.m. to 5:00 a.m., 7 days a week to the new hours of 11:00 p.m. to 10:00 a.m., 7 days a week. By extending the overnight on-street permit parking hours, residents will have improved parking flexibility and the Parking Enforcement Unit, Toronto Police Service, can effectively control long term parking by non-residents through tagging and towing operations.
Item TE29.59 was withdrawn from the Agenda
